slots.name: Monkey Punch
slots.description: Right punch with a target-locking lunge

slots.name: Air Kick
slots.description: Quick aerial kick that lunges toward the target

slots.name: Whirlpool Spin
slots.description: Tuck into your shell and spin once, splashing fighters around you before popping back out.

slots.name: Air Whirlpool Spin
slots.description: Spin in your shell while carrying your airborne momentum, then pop out and fall.

slots.name: Rising Shell
slots.description: Tuck into your shell, strike diagonally forward and up, then pull back and land on the same spot.

slots.name: Air Diagonal Shell
slots.description: Strike forward and up from your shell while carrying airborne momentum, then unfold back into falling.

slots.name: Hose Down
slots.description: Hold to pump the water blaster while aiming with the camera, release to spray a stream that pushes instead of hurting. The longer she pumps, the longer and stronger the stream; in the air it pushes her back.

slots.name: Ring Bounce
slots.description: Throw the ring ahead, hop automatically onto it, compress, then spring high. Movement input at the spring trades some height for horizontal reach; neutral maximizes height. Works with ordinary jumps spent.

slots.name: Shell Slide
slots.description: Tuck into your shell and slide off fast, armoured and steered with the stick. The first fighter you meet is bowled over and you pop out. A miss leaves you flipped on your back, paddling. Off a ledge you slide on thin air, look down and drop.

slots.name: Aerosol Inferno
slots.description: Shake and point an aerosol can, then project a forward fire column
